reviews.comment: Sweet and funny guy but his lectures get confusing. Just take down the notes and use them to do the homework. The homework is 80% identical to the tests except the final which was like 60%. People complain that he recycles homework on tests but why would you not want the answers beforehand? Make sure you go to class for extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Clearly a smart person, but wastes a lot of time in class going over the theory that never seems to really be on homework or tests. A unique sense of humor and inquisitive lecturer. Tests are copy and paste beside the final which is extremely difficult as the class average was a failing grade for it. In-class questions daily to track attendance.

Professor Velez tries to be a nice guy, but he does not make sense. His lectures have literally nothing to do with the homework or exams. Study the homework for a chance to get a B on exams. Also on the optional final exam the highest grade was a 78.3 and he didn't curve... So good luck.

Lectures were not helpful for me at all! I went to the online help desk and just studied the homework for exams. The class was online and there are participation points for extra credit. I did fine in the class but did not learn very much. He seems like a nice guy I just did not understand the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Not bad, just lame. Lectures would make better ASMR than teaching; he talks really softly and isn't particularly engaging. I learned the material by doing the homework. Said homework is basically identical to the exams, often re-using questions between the two, which is nice. You'll get an A but won't enjoy the material like with another prof.

Avoid taking this class with Velez if possible. Pointless to go to lectures because you'll leave more confused than before. Definitely recommend getting the textbook because you'll learn more from that. Exams are a lot like the homework but still not easy. Not a good professor, smart guy, but just can't really teach what he knows.

Velez is funny and a nice guy, but sometimes he can be hard to understand during lecture when the topic is more confusing. Use the hw to teach yourself the material since tests are almost identical to those and you get unlimited attempts. I stopped reading the textbook after the first test and still got an A, but I went to lectures and did fine.

Lectures will only make sense if you read the textbook. HW's & tests are very similar. Use explanations on HW to help teach yourself the material. Extra credit for participation-worth 3 pts to your final grade & unlimited attempts on HW. Prof is caring & gives his students every opportunity to succeed, but you will have to work for an A.

Dont even attend lecture itll just confuse you. You can get extra credit for attendance but they email you the morning of so if you have an early class you better be up just incase. All you need to study is the HW for exams so your basically teaching yourself everything for this class. would NOT recommend.

He's not a great lecturer but it doesn't matter since he uploads lecture notes online. I barely went to class and I still got an A. Just use the explanations for the answers on the homeworks to teach you what is going on for the exams. The class itself is pretty easy, as long as you study for exams properly like any other class.

I never used the course pack. It was too confusing. He won't teach you the homework and/or what will be on the test. He will only teach theory during class. Make sure that you know how to do the homework. Just show up to class and get your attendance extra credit points. I went to 4.0 and go and they taught me everything that I needed to know.

This professor goes over theories in class and not the material needed for homework. It is extremely difficult to learn the concepts on your own for this class. He is very hard to understand and so is the lecture packet. You will not do well on the exams unless you know how to do the hw extremely well.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Velez might be the worst prof I've had at TAMU. The homework is very similar to the tests, but he doesn't explain any of it in class. He disrespects students and does not care. Also not very helpful during office hours. He stated on the first day of class "I'm tenured; there's nothing they can do to me." AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He's an awful professor. He has entertaining lectures and a way of making you feel okay in-class, as soon as you get to the homework/tests it's an entirely different story. It's incredibly difficult and there's no guidance, can't reference your class notes for help (they're useless for this). Spent 4+ hours on each assignment to no avail. Avoid!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests are really just like the homework, you should really study the homework. He gives bonus points if you attend class everyday. He is a really smart economist and a good person, but not great at explaining. It's a hard class if you don't love economics and want to understand it. I feel like I learned nothing in the class.

Velez is hilarious! He teaches by explaining theory, but rarely solves example problems which can make HW and Exams tough if you don't understand. +3pts for i-clicker quizzes. Exams are very similar to HW (though #'s are changed or ?'s inverted) This class is pretty difficult but if you put in the effort an 'A' is 100% achievable! WOULD TAKE AGAIN!

Velez cares about the success of his students but he's just a bad professor. The exams are pretty much mirror images of the homework in most cases. Only reason to go to class is to get the 3 extra credit points. He also allowed multiple attempts on the HW about 3/4 of the semester in. He hates 4.0 but they can be helpful if you don't understand.

Dr. Velez is a very smart economist, but if you study his lecture notes for the test you will likely fail. The tests are just like the homework... EXACTLY like the homework. 4.0 notes are definitely a help but not required if you can put the work in. Study and even memorize the homework and you will get an A. Go to class and get 3 bonus points.

This guy is great. Sit in the front row and ask questions and you should be fine (plus 4.0 and go). He doesn't do example problems in class due to it being a 'theory' course. Velez is likeable and it's a very interesting course if you love econ.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: NICE GUY, CAN EASILY MAKE AN A IF YOU GO TO OFFICE HOURS AND GET HELP ON HOMEWORK. PRINT OFF HOMEWORK AS SOON AS HE POSTS IT AND TAKE IT TO CLASS, SO U CAN FILL IN THE HW DURING CLASS CUZ HE USES SIMILAR QUESTIONS. HES SO HELPFUL. MEMORIZE HWs FOR THE EXAMS AND GOOD TO STUDY OTHER PPLS HWs TOO CUZ SOME QUESTIONS DIFFERENT

Velez tells you exactly how to get an A; memorize and understand the hws- if you dont- go to 4.0 and they give you the hws and the exams. Really easy to get an A. 4.0 teaches you everything, show up to class just for attendance and you get +3 points on your overall grade. You can work on other things in class he doesnt care and he doesnt teach.
he's just arrogant, attempts to state that there are multiple ways to solve a problem BUT NEVER actually does it. also doesn't clearly specify what you need for class like scantrons

Velez is nice but is not the best at explaining, and the only reason you should go to class (if you are just trying to get through it, and not care about the material), is if there is an I-clicker.. THE HOMEWORK IS THE EXAM, go to 4.0 and get the packet and memorize answers.. youll pass
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He tells you on the first day of class and in the syllabus that he will not teach what is on the test or homework. Terribly banal. However, he does give extra credit for attending class and taking i-clicker quizzes. The class would be the same with or without a prof.

Velez is A good professor And teaches the the theory behind All of the material very well. The homework does require you to apply the lecture material. The tests Are pretty easy if you do the homework to the point of understanding it.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: The lectures were mostly a waste of time because the materials covered were sent out in a detailed notes packet online. The homeworks are difficult, but the tests come straight from the homeworks, which he gives the answers to after the due date. If you study and remember homework questions, you should do fine on the tests.

This class is very hard. Go to 4.0 and go for everything and you'll get the help you need. The test is based on the homework and if you memorize answers you can pull a B. Go to class for the iclickers to get up to 3 points added to your semester average.

Awful professor! I have read through the notes posted online and my notes from class and still can't understand how to do the home work. The only way I received decent grades on the homework was going to tutoring 3 days a week and staying 2.5 - 3 hours each time (also 4.0 & go). The tutors are able to help, but I still don't understand it myself.

Absolutely Awful. The only way he gets by w/o his class failing is 4.0 & Go. His lectures have nothing to do with the HW, & the tests are just like the HW. 4.0 will get you an A on HW's so you can review (6 assign, 4% each). Three tests, Cumulative final (33%). 3 pts extra credit at the end if u miss one or less classes (attendance). Terrible Class

The class isn't difficult at all if you show up to all of the lectures, listen to what he says during the lectures, and put in the work for the homework. Once you finish the homework, get the answers from it and study them. That's the exam.

His lectures are hard to follow and are useless. 4.0 is the only way to pass the class. The homework is confusing and doesn't go with the lectures at all. The exams are exact questions from the homework. If you can afford 4.0 and go, then you will get an A in the class.  otherwise, good luck.

4.0 is lifesaving, they give you all the answers to the homework and the homework is exactly what is on the tests! Would not have passed by going to only lectures. Compared to Anderson I think Velez may be easier just because his homework is what you can expect on the test. Glad I had him, the course is tough no matter what so get help!

Honestly he seems like a cool guy, but as a teacher ehhh. What's nice is that the tests are exactly like the HW and that he gives clicker extra credit. What's not nice is that you literally HAVE to go to 4.0 to do the hw, which is the only way you will pass the class. Go to class for clicker but just do HW for other classes while you're there.

This guy is actually not too bad of a professor. As someone who's taken a couple of econ classes so far, he's one of my favorites. The tests are also basically a shot for shot replica of the homework PLUS the grade you get on the final exam will replace your lowest test grade. He also dishes out extra credit if you go to class and do clicker ?'s.

If you're like me and cannot afford 4.0 and go, then goodluck! One of the worst mistakes ever was taken him. His HW are awful. His wording on the HW are ridiculous and his lecture notes do not help with the HW. He does not show you how to get the right answers, he assumes that everyone should just automatically know how to do everything. 0/10
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Velez's lectures are extremely boring He has participation credit which can help boost your grade. Most people had no idea how to do hw so go to4.0. His exams are STRAIGHT from the hw so redo the hw to prepare for exams. However his final is cumulative and from notes. Overall, if you do well on the exams and hw and ok on final, you'll prob get an A
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring, forces class to answer questions that seem rhetorical. Too much time on information we know and not enough on the info we don't. His homework is all online and his lectures often run a week behind the homework's due date, so it is a real struggle. I took homework to the ECON tutoring lab and they didn't even understand it.

He often ends up reading word for word off of his slides on his lecture notes which are posted online. 2 HW's due before each test, these are long and hard but 4.0 and go offers HW sessions so you can get an A which is good bc they are each 4% of your grade. He curves at the end of the semester based on attendance. Tests are straight from HWs.
